messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
On 1 February 2027, what is the highest penalty that Italy would impose on a manufacturer that violates Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

response.text: Il 1 February 2027, quale sarebbe la sanzione massima che l'Italia imporrebbe a un fabbricante che viola il Regolamento (UE) 2023/1230?
